A '''Mon Calamari helmet''' was a type of [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] used by high-ranking [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. It offered the wearer moderate protection and featured a built-in communications device.<ref name="Hasbro" /> [[Thaneespi/Legends|Thaneespi]] and [[Loci Rosen]] were known to have worn this type of helmet.<ref name="CCG Death Star II">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=First Officer Thaneespi}}</ref><ref name="CCG Tatooine">{{CCG|set=Tatooine Limited|cardname=Loci Rosen}}</ref>

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mon Calamari helmet was originally meant to be worn by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] in {{Film|VI}}, but other [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] ended up wearing it in the film.<ref name="costumes">''[[Star Wars Costumes: The Original Trilogy]]''</ref>
